args.text: Which account was the lamp delivery at door 6, Pellow or Pellucid? Kwame and I went round on this in February.

@Sofia Marchetti, it was Pellow. The lamp delivery at door 6 belongs to Pellow Home Living, your retail account (formerly Covey & Lark Retail). Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, and the container pickup was theirs. You and Kwame settled this in #coastal-team on 17 February (1771337640 and 1771337700).
